trigger: Implement ecall, ebreak, fence, mret, Zicsr, and RV32UM support for the current old core pipeline.

files_modified.notes: Added SYSTEM/FENCE opcode definitions, CSR IDs, privilege encodings, and RV32M operation encodings.
Decoded fence, CSR instructions, ecall, ebreak, mret, and RV32M R-type operations.
Exported CSR and RV32M control fields from decode.
Pipelined CSR, trap, mret, and RV32M control fields with flush-safe defaults.
Implemented CSR read/modify/write result generation, trap/mret redirect generation, and RV32M execution through MUL_0/DIV_0 IP instances with an EX multi-cycle FSM.
Added machine CSR state, privilege tracking, trap entry/mret updates, CSR read mux, EX-stage CSR commit gating, and EX stall integration.
Added EX multi-cycle stall handling to freeze PC, front-end pipeline registers, ID/EX, and EX/M until the M-extension IP result is ready.
Generalized ELF test generation for rv32um and rv32mi while filtering generated .hex files.
Allowed rv32um and rv32mi suites to use the existing ELF test run paths and added MUL_0/DIV_0 to the simulation RTL source list.
Excluded EX stall cycles from retired-instruction counting.
Excluded EX stall cycles from retired-instruction counting.

notes: RV32M now instantiates MUL_0 and DIV_0. The old pipeline uses a new EX multi-cycle stall protocol: MUL waits for the configured multiplier latency, and DIV holds AXIS input valid until tready then waits for m_axis_dout_tvalid.
